description: Query booli.se (Swedish property portal) from a shell with the fpx CLI (@fetchproxy/cli) instead of running the booli-mcp server — resolve areas, search for-sale and sold listings (slutpriser), and read property detail via one-shot GraphQL calls through a signed-in browser tab. Use when you want Booli data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
